L corner (same as 249's): E-W leg turns north to Fairview

notes: Names printed without a suffix (RAVINE, CASSATT, VOLKERT, ADA, FLORA, WARNER) are written with 'Street'; EAST VIEW PL. is 'East View Place'; W. McMillan is 'West McMillan Street'. The left part (x < ~850, boundary A-B) overlaps sheet 249: the Fairview NE angle and the South View L corner are repeated here as ties. W. McMillan (60', lines y~287/652) runs across the top. Ravine (60', lines x~3268/3637) runs from Warner north across McMillan onto 258, where it is printed RAVINE and is again 60' with the same lines; recorded as cross. Further west, a 30' opening in McMillan's north line (x~1941/2131, no name printed here) is sheet 257's 'No Name Street (not open)', which ends at McMillan (T; nothing opposite on the south side). Fairview (60') crosses McMillan with a jog: the piece south of McMillan (centreline through (2764,866), slope ~33 deg, water pipe on its centre) meets McMillan's centreline at x~3381, while the piece north of McMillan (SE line from (3769,287), NW line hidden in the Ravine opening; on 258 its lines are 2501/2500, slope ~37 deg) meets it at x~3254, about 127 px further west, so two T points, the north piece written 'Fairview Avenue (north of McMillan)'. Both Fairview points and the Ravine crossing share McMillan's open space between the block corners at (2764,652), (3210,792), (3138,287) and (3769,287). Ada jogs at Ravine: west of Ravine it is 50' (lines y~4379/4679, the street from 249), east of Ravine 40' (lines y~4245/4490), ~160 px further north; written 'Ada Street' and 'Ada Street (east of Ravine)', two T points on Ravine. Cassatt and Volkert (both 40') run from Ravine to Flora and end at both (T). Flora (50', lines x~5325/5637) runs from McMillan (T, the block north of McMillan is continuous) south across Warner (cross); its east line is interrupted by the compass rose around y~1830-2400 (drawing only). East View Place (40') runs from Ravine west to a dead end at x~2222. Warner is 50' west of Ravine (lines y~7178/7478) and 60' east of it (north line steps to y~7119; 60' printed near Flora). McMillan and Warner continue off the right edge onto 251, and the drawn area stops at x~6090. No alleys.
